findings.failing_input: pushCloudKey(STORAGE_KEY, items) — no {immediate:true}. Same CC-01 race as STA-40/41: user adds annotation, hits refresh within 400ms, loses entry.
findings.expected: Use {immediate:true} since adding an annotation is a discrete click.
findings.regression_test_idea: Add annotation → simulate refresh within 400ms → assert persisted in cloud.

findings.failing_input: annotationsInScope filter `store === 'All' || !a.store || a.store === store` — `!a.store` matches empty string OR undefined. Documented: 'null = applies to all stores'. The empty string also passes — likely intentional for legacy data.
findings.regression_test_idea: annotationsInScope with annotation {store:''} → matches every store filter.

findings.failing_input: `return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];` — doesn't validate inner shape. If cloud has a corrupted array like [{}, 'string', null], the consumer would crash when accessing a.date.
findings.fix_sketch: Add `.filter((a): a is Annotation => a && typeof a.id === 'string' && typeof a.date === 'string' && ...)`.
findings.regression_test_idea: Set localStorage to JSON array with malformed entries; assert readAnnotations returns valid-only.

uncertainty_notes: Standard pattern with cloudSync. ANNOTATION_KIND_LABEL/EMOJI/COLOR are clean parallel arrays. annotationsInScope is pure. STA-49 (immediate flag) and STA-51 (shape validation) are the only mild concerns; both MINOR.
